title: Tandem affinity purification of remodeler-mononucleosome complexes for ChIP-seq in mouse embryonic stem cells
protocol: Expand ES cells to twelve 70-80% confluent 10 cm culture dishes.
Culture tagged ES cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 on mitomycin C-inactivated mouse embryonic fibroblasts in DMEM supplemented with necessary components.
Pass the cells into twenty five 10 cm culture dishes coated with gelatin, without feeder cells, the day before the experiment.
Check the aspect and confluence of ES cells 2 hours before starting the protocol on the first day.
Change the medium for ES cells using precisely 10 ml of fresh medium per 10 cm dish.
Incubate the cells further for 2 h at 37°C with 5% CO2 after changing the medium.
Trypsinize one dish and count the cells when the 2 h incubation period in fresh medium is finished.
Remove the cells from the incubator.
Rapidly add 275 μl of formaldehyde 36.5% (Sigma, ref. F8775) to each dish directly into the culture medium and mix well.
Leave the dishes exactly 10 min at room temperature for fixation with formaldehyde.
Dilute DSG to 2 mM in PBS.
Wash the ES cell culture dishes with 10 ml PBS at room temperature, then remove the last bits of PBS by vacuum aspiration.
Add 4 ml of DSG 2mM solution per 10 cm dish and shake gently.
Keep the dishes at room temperature under the hood during 45 min, shaking gently 3-4 times during this period.
Add 4 ml of 2% formaldehyde in PBS to each dish (final concentration 1%) and mix well.
Leave the dishes exactly 10 min at room temperature for fixation with DSG and formaldehyde.
Remove formaldehyde or DSG + formaldehyde solution from the dishes by vacuum aspiration.
Wash each dish twice with cold PBS by vacuum aspiration.
Add 2 ml of PBS with protease inhibitors per dish.
Scrap cells and collect them in four 15 ml conical centrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 1000 rpm, 5 min, 4°C.
Wash each tube of cells twice with 10 ml PBS without protease inhibitors.
Wash each tube of cells once with 5 ml Solution I.
Centrifuge at 1000 rpm, 5 min, 4°C.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 2 ml Solution I with protease inhibitors.
Add 2 ml Solution II with protease inhibitors to the resuspended cell pellets.
Mix gently by pipetting or inverting tubes several times.
Leave for 10 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge at 2000g (3153 rpm using an eppendorf A-4-62 rotor), 4°C, for 10 minutes.
Wash each cell pellet twice with 6 ml MNase buffer without protease inhibitors.
Resuspend each cell pellet in 500 μl MNase buffer without protease inhibitors.
Mix well by pipetting up-and-down approximately 20 times using a P1000 pipetman.
Transfer the cell suspension from each conical centrifuge tube into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Store the tubes on ice.
Dilute MNase to a concentration of 10 units/μl in MNase buffer.
Add MNase to each microfuge tube, using 60-75 units for every 10 million cells.
Mix well with a P1000 pipetman.
Incubate the tubes for 10 minutes at 37°C in a water bath, mixing once by inverting after 5 minutes of incubation.
Transfer the tubes onto ice and add 20 μl EDTA (100 mM pH8), 10 μl Complete 50x, and 5 μl PMSF 0.1M to each tube.
Store the tubes on ice.
Perform 4 cycles of sonication using a Diagenode Bioruptor with settings of 20 seconds ON / 40 seconds OFF.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Collect and pool the supernatants from the four tubes to obtain input chromatin.
Discard the pellets.
Collect an 80 μl aliquot of this input chromatin for DNA analysis and quantification as well as western blot analysis.
Add 20 μl of input chromatin, 480 μl H2O, 20 μl NaCl 5M, and 0.5 μl RNase A (30 μg/μl) in a new microfuge tube.
Incubate overnight at 65°C.
Add 10 μl EDTA 0.5M, 20 μl Tris-HCl 1M pH8.0, and 4 μl proteinase K 10 mg/ml to the solution.
Incubate for 2 h at 55°C.
Add 500 μl Phenol/Chloroform to the mixture, vortex for 30 s, and centrifuge for 10 min at 13000 rpm at room temperature.
Collect the aqueous phase and transfer it to a new microfuge tube.
Add 50 μl of NaAc 3M pH 5.2 to the collected aqueous phase and mix thoroughly.
Add 1 ml of -20°C 100% ethanol to the mixture, and invert the tubes ten times.
Precipitate DNA for 1 h at -20°C or overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge the samples for 15 min at 4°C, 13000 rpm. Discard the supernatant and centrifuge again for 30 s to remove any remaining liquid.
Wash the DNA pellet with 500 μl of 70% ethanol, then centrifuge and discard all liquid.
Add 20 TE (Tris-HCl pH8, 0.1 mM EDTA) to the washed DNA pellet.
Quantify DNA by measuring OD at 260 nm.
Run the DNA onto a 1.3% agarose gel to analyze mono- and oligo-nucleosomes in the input chromatin.
Resuspend the beads.
Pipette 80 μl of beads into a 15 ml conical centrifuge tube for the first immunoprecipitation step.
Wash the beads three times with 10 ml TKNSE buffer.
Centrifuge one minute at 1000 rpm between each wash to collect the beads.
Keep the beads at 4°C until use.
Mix 500 μl of input chromatin with 20 μl of HA antibody-agarose beads in four 1.5 ml microfuge tubes.
Incubate overnight at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Pool the content of the four microfuge tubes into a 15 ml conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for two minutes at 1000 rpm, at 4°C.
Take an 80 μl aliquot of the unbound fraction as a control for western blot analysis and store on ice.
Wash the beads eight times with 10 ml TEGN.
Resuspend in 500 μl TEGN if elution is to be made by TEV proteolysis, or in 300 μl of TEGN for elution by peptide competition.
Take a 10 μl aliquot of the bead suspension to control the efficiency of the first immunoprecipitation by western blot and store on ice until analysis.
Add 50 μl TEV (1 mg/ml) to the beads.
Incubate for 6 h at 30°C using a thermomixer set at 750 rpm, ensuring gentle mixing.
Resuspend the bead pellet in 300 μl TEGN and transfer into a 500 μl microfuge tube.
Add 100 μl of peptide (4 μg/μl) to the beads.
Add protease inhibitors: 8 μl Complete 50x and 4 μl PMSF 0.1 M.
Incubate overnight at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Transfer the mixture of beads and elution solution into a centrifuge column (Pierce®, 0.8 ml, ref. 89868).
Centrifuge for 1 min at 8000 rpm at room temperature.
Collect the eluate in a 1.5 ml microfuge tube, store on ice.
Take an aliquot of the eluate (e.g., 10 μl) and store on ice.
Add 40 μl of beads coupled to the second antibody to the eluate from the first purification step.
Incubate overnight at 4°C on a rotating wheel.
Transfer the content of the microfuge tube, including beads in suspension, into a 15 ml conical centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 1000 rpm at 4°C.
Take an 80 μl aliquot of the unbound fraction of the second IP. Keep on ice until analysis.
Wash 8 times with 10 ml TEGN.
Centrifuge at 4°C for 2 minutes at 1000 rpm after each wash.
Resuspend in 300 μl TEGN, including beads, and transfer into a 500 μl microfuge tube.
Add 100 μl of competitor peptide (4 μg/μl).
Incubate for 5 hours at room temperature on a rotating wheel.
Transfer the beads and eluate into a Pierce centrifuge column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 8000 rpm, at room temperature.
Collect the eluate into a 1.5 ml microfuge tube. Store this sample containing chromatin eluted by peptide competition on ice.
Collect a 40 μl aliquot for western blot analysis from the eluate.
Keep the beads for the second elution step with SDS elution buffer.
Add 400 μl of preheated (55°C) SDS elution buffer to the beads.
Agitate for 15 minutes on a thermomixer at 55°C.
Transfer the mixture, including beads and eluate, into a centrifuge column.
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 8000 rpm at room temperature.
Collect the eluate in a 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Take a 40 μl aliquot of eluate and store on ice or until Western blot analysis.
Run samples collected from protocol steps on protein gel running and blotting system.
Directly add SDS-PAGE sample loading buffer to agarose beads, heat as for liquid samples.
Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 13000 rpm.
Load supernatant onto the gel.
Add 170 μl H2O and 20 μl NaCl 5M to eluates.
Incubate overnight at 65°C.
Add 10 μl EDTA 0.5M, 20 μl Tris-HCl 1M pH8.0, and 4 μl proteinase K 10 mg/ml.
Incubate for 2 hours at 55°C.
Add 500 μl Phenol/Chloroform to the mixture.
Vortex for 30 seconds.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 13000 rpm at room temperature.
Collect the aqueous phase and transfer to a new 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Add 25 μg glycogen and 50 μl NaAc 3M pH 5.2 to the collected sample.
Mix well.
Add 1 ml of -20°C 100% ethanol to the mixture.
Invert tubes 10 times to mix.
Precipitate DNA for 1 hour at -20°C or overnight at 4°C.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 4°C, 13000 rpm.
Collect and discard the supernatant.
Centrifuge again for 30 seconds and discard the last drop of liquid.
Wash the DNA-glycogen pellet with 500 μl of 70% ethanol.
Centrifuge and discard all the liquid.
Dry the pellet for 15-30 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet in 20 μl of H2O.
Quantify the DNA using a Picogreen DNA detection kit.
